messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (next steps)

Hi Sofia / Kevin —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC running next week. I captured the items we talked through and a draft set of success criteria / KPIs below. Please flag anything that looks off.

High-level POC plan (2 weeks):
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for realtime payment routing assistant (authorization predictions + intent classification) at production-like load.
- Duration: 2 weeks of instrumented testing + 1-week follow-up for analysis
- Owners: Jordan (sales lead / product coordination), Marissa (solutions & onboarding), Rishi (CS / ops liaison)

Proposed success criteria & KPIs (draft):
1) Latency
   - 95th percentile inference latency <= 150 ms (at target payload size)
   - 99th percentile tail latency target: <= 250 ms (informational)
2) Throughput
   - Sustained throughput target: 200 req/s for the primary model; support burst to 400 req/s for 60s windows
3) Cost
   - Average cost per token (inference): <= $0.0008/token on the agreed model/quantization profile
   - Provide cost projection for 100k monthly active queries
4) Quality
   - Intent classification precision >= 95% on agreed test set
   - Hallucination/incorrect action rate < 2% on evaluation prompts
5) Reliability / Ops
   - No dropped requests; error rate <= 0.5% during test windows

Evaluation plan & artifacts needed from Atlas:
- Shared test corpus (CSV) of ~2k representative queries (we received sample subset today; request full set by EOD Thu 4/22)
- Definition of "intent match" and example labels (ground truth)
- Peak/typical payload sizes and traffic profile (req/s distribution)

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm the test corpus and ownership by EOD Thu 4/22
2) We send a short SOW + POC plan and test harness (Doc + Drive link) by 4/21 — sign/ack to proceed
3) Kickoff engineering setup: schedule for Mon 4/26 (30–60 min) to wire up data ingest and monitoring
4) Mid-point check-in (end of week 1) and final analysis within 3 business days after test window

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (POC scope & instrumentation) and atlas_test_prompts.csv (sample)

If that all looks good I can send the formal POC doc and a calendar invite for the Mon 4/26 kickoff.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (next steps)

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side before we sign the SOW: 

- The latency targets look reasonable; can you confirm how latency is measured (end-to-end request vs inference-only)? We care about end-to-end from our service gateway.
- For cost/token: do those estimates assume 8-bit quantization + shared cache? Can you provide the model variant and any assumptions you used for the $0.0008/token estimate?
- On quality: we can provide labeled intent examples but would like to include a small holdout for manual review to confirm false positives. Is that OK?

Also, are you able to support a stricter SLA on tail latency if we move to Dedicated capacity? We may want to measure both hosted and dedicated options during the POC.

If you can respond to these three points I can get back to Procurement about the SOW next week.

Best,
Sofia Morales
Director, Data Products
Atlas Payments
sofia@atlas-payments.com

Sofia / Kevin — following up with updates and the formal POC doc attached. Per Marissa's note we've clarified the assumptions in the POC doc:

- Latency definition: we will report both "inference-only" (server-side time) and "end-to-end" (round-trip from your gateway to Redwood inference and back). The 95th target of 150 ms is for inference-only; we will jointly agree an end-to-end target during setup and instrument it.
- Cost assumptions: estimate uses model variant rwd-3.8b (8-bit quantized) with shared prefix cache assumptions. Detailed line-item cost projection is section 3 of the attached PDF.
- Quality plan: we will reserve 10% holdout from your uploaded labeled set for manual review as requested.

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (updated), atlas_test_prompts.csv
